policy: Amendments are allowed only while no heldout candidate score has been observed. Each round records what had been observed at the time it was written.

amendments: Follow section 2.1: public sources 8+14=22, correcting section 9 typo 32.
Fix previously unspecified speed/association/smoothing details before any extractor audit.
For object_shape only, verify the prescribed twofold mask aspect-ratio change; event invariance is compatible with shape error.
Use annotation-only kinematics independent of the RGB event extractor for truth.
Report true fragmentation only in annotation audit, not as an inferred certified RGB statistic.
unchanged: Synthetic event recall and precision each at least 0.8.
Synthetic object recall at least 0.8; public object scores diagnostic only.
No candidate pair scores before required gates pass.
No formula, threshold, or score-type retuning after heldout score inspection.

rounds.rationale: The round-1 gate failed for two separate reasons: a flow-only extractor cannot keep a stationary object present, so start/stop were recorded as enter/exit (31 and 15 nearest-event confusions); and turn recall was 8/16 even though type-agnostic matching reached 68/96. The STA support rule accepted a keyframe timestamp without readable content, attributing a channel fault to generation.
amendments: Section 3: split ERE extraction into a presence channel (SAM2.1/DINOv2 tracks, as in object_metric.py) and a motion channel (RAFT residual flow). start/stop become motion-state transitions of a persisting presence track; enter/exit become presence-track birth/death.
Section 3: add a mandatory development-only re-selection of the turn-detection parameters (smoothing window, minimum speed, before/after angle), recorded before the re-audit.
Section 3: declare public-video ERE diagnostic-only, because the presence channel reached only 20.3% public object-frame recall.

Section 4.1: support now requires decodable content that agrees with the unit state, using the same tolerances as event matching. A keyframe whose content cannot be read (packet loss, checksum failure, extraction failure) counts as unsupported, so content corruption appears in CLR rather than GFR.
Section 4.3: add a mandatory six-case rule unit check; corrupt_keyframe_retained must yield CLR=1 with GFR 0 or null before any STA experiment runs.
Section 6: add presence-track recall, turn recall and the STA rule check as declared gates, and record the numbers of every development re-audit round.
Section 10: the revised metric code changes file hashes, so a new prepare run and output directory are required; the round-1 directory is preserved as the gate-failure record.
unchanged: Adoption criteria in section 7.2: AUC >= 0.9, detection rate >= 0.8, control false alarm <= 0.1, coverage >= 0.95, and the paired-bootstrap advantage rule.
Mandatory gate level of 0.8 for synthetic event recall, event precision and object recall.
The ERE/SER and EDR/CLR/GFR/GHR formulas themselves.
Heldout sources and renderer seeds; no heldout candidate score has been computed.
No merging of start/enter or stop/exit and no threshold lowering to pass the gate.
rounds.residual_risk: These amendments were written after seeing development-set gate numbers, which is the purpose of that set, but repeated development re-audits can overfit the extractor to it. Every re-audit round is logged here, and heldout sources stay unused until the mandatory gates pass. The revised ERE now depends on SAM2/DINOv2, so the round-1 rationale of keeping indicator 1 free of segmentation models no longer holds.

rounds.selection_rule: maximize minimum(event recall, event precision, turn recall), then event F1, then proximity to baseline
observations: Both the two-channel baseline and selected setting already recover 16/16 turns; parameter selection primarily improves precision, not turn recall.
Compared with the two-channel baseline, precision rises from 87.7358% to 92%, recall changes from 96.875% to 95.8333%.
Development diagnostics are tuning evidence, not independent validation.
implementation_details: Presence uses unmodified ObjectExtractor and associate_frames.
Activity uses mask-mean camera-subtracted flow with two-frame state persistence.
Turn direction uses camera-stabilized centroids, selected odd-width smoothing, and separate before/after context.
Minimum per-track event separation remains three frames; presence boundary events take priority, then local angle peaks, then motion-state changes.
Stationary enter/exit retains the existing zero-speed direction convention.
Decoded keyframe state must agree with the event; failed decoding/checksum/extraction is unsupported, while an intact caption can still independently support it.

rounds.reaudit_scope: synthetic development 16 and public development 8; no heldout metric/model inference
rounds.public_precision_scope: correspondence ratio to selected DAVIS object annotations, not exhaustive real-event precision
notes: All required synthetic and STA rule gates passed at the unchanged 0.8 thresholds.
Development parameter selection and re-audit use the same development sources; this is not independent generalization evidence.
Formal ERE/SER error detection, baseline comparison and STA decoded-video attribution accuracy remain unrun.
